analysis.title: UBS House View Briefcases - Top 10 questions answered
key_insights: VIX reached nearly 36 on 20 November, its highest since the April 2025 Liberation Day tariff turmoil. UBS suggests capital preservation and structured yield strategies (put warrants, reverse convertibles) to use elevated vol.
S&P 500 is in correction, down 11.5% from its 6 October high. Nasdaq is down 19.8%, near bear market territory, after falling 5.3% on 20 November while the S&P fell 3.7%.

UBS stays Neutral on global equities but expects gains in 2027 on about 15% earnings growth in the US and Eurozone. It recommends cutting tech concentration and favors health care, industrials and Eurozone equities.
AI capex forecast is USD 1.0tr in 2026, USD 1.4tr in 2027 and USD 1.5tr in 2028. The debate has shifted to whether AI can generate adequate shareholder returns.
Fixed income rated Attractive. UBS favors intermediate duration of about 2 to 10 years, is cautious on the longest-dated bonds, and likes EM and high yield bonds for income.
Treasury yields fell last week as the 2-year dropped nearly 20bp, its best week since August 2025. The 10-year is around 4.95% after a 5.36% intraday high in early October, the highest since 2002.
Commodities: Brent fell to about USD 91.45 from USD 118 at end October on US-Iran de-escalation hopes. UBS prefers broad, actively managed exposure with a tilt to copper and strategic gold.
Gold fell more than 9% in the week to 20 November to near USD 3,500/oz, a 14-month low. UBS still expects a rally toward USD 5,000/oz as real yields and the USD decline.
UBS expects 25bp Fed hikes in December 2026 and March 2027, with consecutive-hike risk rising. October CPI was 0.4% MoM headline and 0.3% core, and Q3 GDP was 3.4% annualized.

The USD index hit a 19-month high on 19 November and eased to 103.6 on 23 November. UBS sees USD strength as temporary into 2027, prefers GBP and EM carry (MXN, ZAR, BRL, INR), and expects CHF to underperform.
Cash: UBS recommends holding two to five years of net withdrawals and phasing excess cash into markets. US stocks beat cash in 97% of 10-year and 100% of 20-year periods since 1945.

US-Iran conflict: Brent is down 21.5% month to date as Gulf crude exports recovered to about 19.5 mbpd. Physical markets are not normalized, with 19 ship attacks in 18 days, depleted inventories, and UBS expects crude to recover.

Alternatives: UBS favors dispersion-driven hedge fund strategies, middle-market private equity, secondaries, core infrastructure and selective senior-secured private debt. Hedge fund assets hit a record USD 5.64tr.
Transformational innovation themes are AI, Power and resources, and Longevity. Power sector investment is expected to reach USD 3tr by 2030 and longevity revenue USD 8tr by 2030.

Diversifies away from tech concentration, with obesity treatment growth and late-stage trial catalysts.
AI is a structural driver but concentration and monetization risks argue for reducing excess exposure.
Fragile shipping flows and low inventories support broad commodity exposure and a crude recovery.

UBS forecasts about 15% Eurozone earnings growth in 2026 and 2027 (forecast), supported by manufacturing recovery and operating leverage.

trade_ideas.rationale: Option premiums convert vol into income.
trade_ideas.risk: Defined equity downside, issuer risk, limited liquidity.

trade_ideas.description: Long GBP and EM carry (MXN, ZAR, BRL, INR) versus USD, underweight CHF
trade_ideas.rationale: USD strength is expected to fade in 2027 as disinflation allows rate-hike expectations to ease.
trade_ideas.risk: Stronger data or deeper risk-off could prop up the dollar.

trade_ideas.description: Long crude oil and broad commodities, with a tilt to copper and gold
trade_ideas.rationale: Attractive near-term risk-reward in crude on cleaner positioning and depleted inventories.

risk_factors: Sustainability and returns of AI spending, plus physical and financing constraints.
Hotter inflation and Fed hikes, including possible moves larger than 25bp.
Fiscal sustainability concerns and hyperscaler debt issuance keeping long yields high.
Renewed attacks on shipping in the Gulf and uncertainty over how long US naval support lasts.
Concentrated equity leadership and high expectations.
vol_and_positioning: VIX reached nearly 36 on 20 November, the highest since April 2025.
Money managers cut Brent net-long positions to the lowest in more than four months, and WTI net longs are at the lowest since January.
UBS says extended USD positioning is likely to unwind in 2027.
Investors with concentrated gains may add a put warrant, and income seekers may consider reverse convertibles to monetize elevated implied vol.
geopolitical: US forces struck a missile launch site on Iran's Qeshm Island on 20 November.
Iran's navy claimed two oil tankers hit mines east of the Strait of Hormuz, and one caught fire.
Gulf crude exports recovered to about 19.5 mbpd in October with US naval escorts, but 19 ship attacks were reported in the first 18 days of November.
China Investment Corporation reportedly seeks to resume investing in US private equity funds with protections against sanctions.

tension_points.bull_case: Resilient growth and about 15% 2027 earnings growth should help equities absorb a measured Fed tightening cycle.
tension_points.bear_case: High expectations, concentrated AI leadership and hot inflation with possible larger hikes raise downside risk.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Fed hikes larger than 25bp if inflation proves more persistent, per the October minutes.

tension_points.bull_case: Depleted inventories, ship attacks and rising Chinese imports should drive a crude recovery.
tension_points.bear_case: Gulf exports are near pre-war levels and US de-escalation hopes plus softer demand weigh on prices.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Sustained normalization of refined-product exports and lasting US-Iran de-escalation.
